page.layout: Running head at top, with page number 108 at top left. One column of text. Marginal notes in the left margin, beside the first lines of the column. Catchword "Addin-" at lower right below the last line.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic, & Amaf.

main_text.l: venio ad annum usque M. cccc. lxxxi.
Interim Eppone quoque rebus humanis
anno M.cccc. xli i i, aut M. cccc. xliii-
i. exempto[?], qui in parte juris priftini, quod
habere fe à majoribus exiftimabat, in
Præfectura vetere remanserat, Gronin-
gani confensu populi, & pacto quodam
cum Eppone freti, arcem ejus Brocae-
am, dejecto præsidio, & vidua Epponis
Frouwa Ulrici Grethani sorore, occu-
parunt, universumque imperium præto-
rium secundùm Dullarti oram in se ver-
terunt, salvo reliquo jure, libertate αὐτο-
νομία populi. Datusque à senatu præfe-
ctus, qui diceret jus, à quo provocatio
ad senatum & civitatem esset. In eaque
conditione libens tota illa ora ad Dul-
larum sine mutatione ulla perstitit usque
ad tempora Saxonica, seque à Rep. &
societate reliquarum agri hujus partium
sejunxit, nec exportandi importandi-
ve lege, nec cæteris istarum pactis cum
civitate obligata ab eo tempore fuit. Hoc
exemplo vicini Westerwoldii commoti,
cum longius tendere, quàm à majori-
bus relictum acceperat, usurpare Eggo

marginalia.note: Eppone moriuo,re-liquaPræ-fectura veteris ci-vitati Groning. accesfere.

page.notes: Marginal note text is printed in small italic type at the left margin; the hyphenated words are kept as printed. "exempto" and "xli i i" are doubtful readings. The Greek word is split across the line end at "αὐτο-" / "νομία". "Westerwoldii" is read from a worn word and may be "Wefterwoldii" in print. Show-through and the digitiser mark at the lower right are left out.
